Cryptography and AI

This module will look at fundamental aspects of the technology that underlies an enterprise-grade network.

Learning Objectives for this module:

+  Critically discuss the principles and concepts of cryptography for computer systems.

+  Discuss, design and justify the decisions of an exemplar cryptography approach for computer security.

+  Analyse, apply and evaluate the application of artificial intelligence technologies to cryptography.

+  Critically discuss the ethical and legal issues involved in security of computer and AI systems.
